Room.title: Room
Room.description: Represents a room in the Hotel Maxim.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Room entity.

roomType.description: The type of the room (e.g., Single, Double, Suite).

description.description: A detailed description of the room.

price.description: The price of the room per night.

amenities.description: A list of amenities available in the room.

imageUrl.description: URL of an image representing the room.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Represents a booking made by a user.

checkIn.description: Firestore Timestamp of the check-in date.

checkOut.description: Firestore Timestamp of the check-out date.

createdAt.description: Firestore Timestamp of when the booking was created.

status.description: The current status of the booking.

totalPrice.description: The total price for the stay.

Availability.title: Availability
Availability.description: Represents a single booked night for a specific room type.

roomType.description: The type of room that is booked (e.g., 'double', 'deluxe').

date.description: The specific date that is unavailable (YYYY-MM-DD).

bookingId.description: Reference to the booking that made this date unavailable.

bookingCount.description: The number of bookings for this room type on this date.

RoomType.title: RoomType
RoomType.description: Defines a type of room and its total inventory.

name.description: The name of the room type (e.g., 'Single', 'Double').

totalRooms.description: The total number of rooms available of this type.

UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user profile information, including their role.

MenuItem.title: Menu Item
MenuItem.description: Represents a single item on the restaurant menu.

name.description: The name of the menu item.

price.description: The price of the item, as a formatted string (e.g., '35 RON').

description.description: A short description of the menu item.

imageUrl.description: URL of an image for the menu item.

MenuPage.title: Menu Page
MenuPage.description: Represents a single page in the restaurant menu flipbook.

title.description: The title of the menu page (e.g., 'Aperitive', 'Fel Principal').

items.description: The list of menu items on this page.

Menu.title: Menu
Menu.description: Represents the entire restaurant menu, composed of multiple pages.

pages.description: An ordered list of pages that make up the menu.

firestore.reasoning: Given the requirement to store room data for the Hotel Maxim website, a straightforward collection-based structure is suitable. We will create a single collection called `rooms` to store all room documents. This structure is simple and scalable, and it doesn't require any authorization logic, as all the data will be publicly accessible. This design supports the QAPs because there's no role-based authorization needed (all rooms are listable and readable).
